about: TZX block 4, the loader: 256 bytes loaded at $FF00, which copies itself to $5E00 and runs there: python3 ../../kit/mkgame.py --part src/loader/loader.json --install
header: ; MASK III: VENOM Strikes Back, Gremlin Graphics 1988: TZX block 4, the loader (256 bytes at $FF00). Its first
; 15 bytes copy the rest to $5E00 and jump there; the copy loads the screen, tests for 128K paging, loads the game
; and on a 128K the music into RAM 4. The block's last 74 bytes are what the stack held when it was saved.
